title: Bitwarden vs LastPass
description: Bitwarden vs LastPass: the stored editorial scores are Bitwarden 4.7/5 and LastPass 4.1/5, with Bitwarden currently recorded as the provisional pick. Scores, winner rationale, and current pricing have not yet passed a source-linked evidence audit; verify plan details directly with each vendor before deciding.

features.name: Free tier availability
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers a free tier with essential features for getting started. Free tiers include core functionality with usage limits.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides a free tier for small teams. Freemium models reduce initial investment risk.

features.name: Entry-level pricing
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden starts at Freemium (Free – $10/mo per user). This tier supports small teams with core features. See Security & Compliance pricing guide.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass begins at Freemium (Free – $6/user/mo). TCO should include per-user fees, storage overages, and premium add-ons.

features.name: Enterprise pricing
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers custom enterprise pricing with SLA-backed support and advanced security. Includes audit logging and data residency.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides enterprise tiers with volume discounts. SSO, compliance certs, and custom SLAs included.

features.name: Annual discount
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers 15-20% savings with annual billing. TCO cost reduction for committed teams with multi-year contract options.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides annual billing with 15-25% savings. SaaS pricing analysis confirms typical annual commitment benefits.

features.name: Free trial duration
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides a 14-30 day free trial with access to all core features. This trial period allows teams to thoroughly evaluate the platform against their specific workflows, test integrations with existing tools, and assess overall performance before making a financial commitment. Many teams use this period to run parallel operations and validate migration paths.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers a similar trial duration with full feature access. We strongly recommend our structured evaluation checklist to maximize trial effectiveness, including checking integration compatibility, testing API endpoints, and evaluating performance under your typical workload conditions.

features.name: Contract flexibility
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers month-to-month, annual, and multi-year contract options. Monthly billing provides flexibility for teams still evaluating fit, while annual contracts reduce per-unit costs. SaaS contract terms typically include usage-based scaling and add-on modules.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides flexible contract terms with monthly and annual options. Multi-year commitments often include additional discounts and waived implementation fees for enterprise customers.

features.name: Usage-based scaling
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden scales pricing based on team size, storage, and feature tier. Usage-based pricing ensures you only pay for what you need, with automatic upgrades as your team grows. Industry benchmarks help forecast costs at scale.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers similar usage-based scaling with clear upgrade paths. TCO modeling should include expected growth over 12-24 months when comparing platforms.

features.name: User role management
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides RBAC with customizable permission levels supporting complex hierarchies and compliance.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers role management with SCIM provisioning for SSO-based user lifecycle management.

features.name: Two-factor authentication
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden supports 2FA via TOTP, SMS, and FIDO2 hardware keys. Zero-trust benefits from MFA enforcement.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides 2FA with authenticator apps and biometrics on mobile. Encryption combined with 2FA provides defense-in-depth.

features.name: Audit logging
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden maintains audit trails for actions and changes. Compliance-ready exports support SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides activity logging with searchable history. SIEM integration enables centralized monitoring.

features.name: Mobile app
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers native iOS and Android apps with push notifications and offline access for mobile workforce productivity.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides mobile apps. Remote team collaboration supported via mobile-optimized interfaces.

features.name: Search functionality
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden features full-text search with filters. AI-powered search suggests relevant results based on usage patterns.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides search with filtering. Global search helps teams find information across workspaces.

features.name: Template library
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides pre-built templates for common workflows. Custom templates support branding and standardization.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers template collections for industries. Workflow templates speed implementation.

features.name: Community ecosystem
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden has a large community. Community contributions extend functionality via plugins and shared resources.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass maintains growing community with user groups and forums.

features.name: Onboarding experience
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers guided onboarding with tutorials and setup wizards. Self-paced learning accelerates proficiency.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides documentation, video tutorials, and live training. Knowledge base covers setup scenarios.

features.name: Multi-language support
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden supports multiple languages with localized interfaces. International teams benefit from regional format support.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides multi-language with interface translations. i18n supports global collaboration.

features.name: Custom branding
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides white-label options with custom domain and branding for client portals.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers branding customization with custom themes and domain config on business plans.

features.name: Bulk operations
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden supports batch processing for data management. API-based bulk operations handle large datasets efficiently, with progress tracking and error reporting built into the workflow.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers bulk import/export in CSV and JSON formats. Scheduled bulk operations support automated data synchronization between systems.

features.name: Data portability
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides full data export capabilities in multiple formats including JSON, CSV, and PDF. API-based data access ensures you maintain control of your information at all times. GDPR data portability requirements are fully supported.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass supports data portability through export tools and API access. Migration in or out of the platform is designed to minimize friction for growing teams.

features.name: Offline mode
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides offline functionality with automatic sync when connectivity is restored. This is critical for field teams, traveling professionals, and environments with unreliable internet access.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers limited offline capabilities with local caching of recent data. Mobile apps provide the most robust offline experience for on-the-go teams.

features.name: SSO/SAML
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden supports SSO via SAML 2.0 with SCIM provisioning for AD sync.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers SSO on mid-tier plans with social login options.

features.name: Encryption at rest
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden uses AES-256 encryption with CMEK on enterprise plans. Data residency controls included.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass encrypts with AES-256 with auto key rotation. SOC 2 standards are met.

features.name: Encryption in transit
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden enforces TLS 1.3 with perfect forward secrecy.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass uses TLS with HTTPS-only API enforcement.

features.name: SOC 2 Type II
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden maintains SOC 2 Type II with annual independent audits.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass is SOC 2 certified with regular assessments.

features.name: GDPR compliance
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden is GDPR compliant with DPA and EU data residency options.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides GDPR features with DPA and data portability.

features.name: HIPAA compliance
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers HIPAA compliance with BAA on enterprise.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass has not independently verified HIPAA compliance — contact vendor for current status.

features.name: Uptime SLA
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden guarantees 99.9% uptime with SLA credits. Multi-region redundancy ensures business continuity.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers competitive SLA commitments with SOC 2 audited availability metrics.

features.name: Data residency
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden data residency options — verified
features.tool2Detail: LastPass data residency options — not independently verified; contact vendor

features.name: Incident response
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden maintains a documented incident response plan with notification timelines aligned to SOC 2 requirements. Security incidents are communicated within SLA-defined windows.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass follows industry-standard incident response procedures with regular tabletop exercises and third-party penetration testing.

features.name: Vulnerability management
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden runs continuous vulnerability scanning and maintains a responsible disclosure program. Third-party security audits are conducted quarterly with results available to enterprise customers.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass performs regular security assessments with automated scanning and manual penetration testing by certified security researchers.

features.name: API access
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides REST and GraphQL APIs with SDKs. Webhooks enable event-driven integrations.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers RESTful API. Automation platforms connect both for no-code workflows.

features.name: Native integrations
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden integrates with Slack, Jira, GitHub, Salesforce.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers API-first architecture for custom connector development.

features.name: Webhook support
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden supports custom webhooks for event-driven workflows and real-time data sync.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides webhook triggers and actions for automation.

features.name: Auto workflow
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden includes workflow automation for common tasks. Automation comparisons help choose complementary tools.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides automation with triggers and conditional logic for complex business processes.

features.name: Reporting and analytics
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers custom dashboards and KPI tracking. Industry benchmarks contextualize metrics.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides reporting with visual analytics and export. ROI tracking demonstrates value.

features.name: Notification system
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides customizable alerts and push, email, and in-app notifications.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers notification controls with configurable triggers.

features.name: Customer support
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden provides knowledge base, email, and chat. Premium tiers include SLA-backed support and account managers.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass offers ticket support and help center. Zendesk integration enables unified ticketing.

features.name: Training resources
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden offers webinars, documentation, and certification programs for team upskilling.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass provides help center and video tutorials for self-paced learning.

features.name: Community support
features.tool1Detail: Bitwarden has large active community forums and user groups for peer support.
features.tool2Detail: LastPass maintains growing community with meetups and events.

verdict: Provisional verdict: Bitwarden is the current recorded pick for teams prioritizing password-manager administration and shared credential workflows; LastPass may fit teams whose requirements and budget align better with its current plans. The stored scores (Bitwarden 4.7/5; LastPass 4.1/5) and winner have not yet passed a source-linked evidence audit, so treat them as provisional editorial ratings rather than verified test results. Before choosing, compare current business-plan pricing, SSO and provisioning support, account recovery, audit logs, admin controls, sharing workflows, and export/migration paths against vendor documentation. Test both products with representative users and verify security and compliance requirements directly with each vendor. Use the software evaluation checklist and security software buyer’s guide linked on this page to structure a fair trial.

faqs.question: What are the key differences between Bitwarden and LastPass?
faqs.answer: Compare core vault features, autofill reliability, password and passkey support, secure sharing, recovery, browser/mobile coverage and the administration tools available on your intended plan. Security and feature availability change over time; confirm the exact requirements against current vendor documentation.

faqs.question: Which is the better password manager?
faqs.answer: The right choice depends on whether you prioritize cost and open-source transparency, ease of setup, family sharing, or organization-level controls. Test autofill and recovery on your own devices before deciding. The recorded winner and editorial scores are provisional pending a source-linked evidence audit, not a verified universal ranking.

faqs.question: What should I check in the free and paid plans?
faqs.answer: Review current plan limits, supported devices, sharing and emergency access, authentication options, organization features, and support. Confirm whether the features you need are included in the plan and region you will actually use.

faqs.question: How do I migrate safely?
faqs.answer: Use the provider's supported import flow, test a small sample, and check passwords, usernames, URLs, secure notes and duplicates. Treat exported vault files as highly sensitive: keep them local, avoid sharing them, and securely delete them after validating the import.

faqs.question: How can I evaluate security without relying on marketing?
faqs.answer: Read current security documentation, encryption and account-recovery explanations, independent audit disclosures where available, and incident-response communications. Distinguish documented controls from broad claims; do not infer that a product is risk-free.

faqs.question: Are the comparison scores independently verified?
faqs.answer: No. Stored scores and winner fields are retained for transparency but remain provisional until the underlying criteria and sources are audited. They are editorial values, not third-party review aggregates or a substitute for your own feature and security checks.
